notes: conditions objects are literal restatements of RULES[].match(d, w) from hospitalityKnowledge.js, where d = dish.tags and w = drink.tags.
phrases.*.text values are copied verbatim from RULES[].clauses[tone].

aiService.js addPerfectPairings()/addFoodPairings() have no cocktail-keyed pairingRules -- neither pairingRules nor foodRules ever list a cocktail/spirit-name keyword group, so there is nothing to add from aiService.js for this domain.

entries.principle: citrus acidity cuts cleanly through richness on the plate
entries.rotation: deterministic-hash (single-variant clause set, no rotation needed)

professional: The citrus in the cocktail cuts cleanly through the richness of the dish.
friendly: The citrus in that cocktail cuts right through the richness, keeps every bite feeling lighter.
luxury: The citrus lift in the cocktail plays nicely against the richness on the plate.

entries.principle: cocktail has enough character/complexity to stand up to a dish without getting lost next to it
entries.rotation: deterministic-hash (single-variant clause set, no rotation needed)

professional: It has enough character to stand up to the dish without getting lost.
friendly: It's got enough going on that it won't get lost next to the {dish}.
luxury: There's enough going on in the glass that it holds its own alongside the dish.

entries.fidelity_note: Originally present in hospitalityKnowledge.js RULES but not captured in the initial extraction pass (flagged as unassigned); added here for completeness so the data-driven rules engine has full parity with the original 21-entry RULES array.

professional: It's refreshing enough to reset the palate between bites.
